purpose: The ONE source for CLAUDE10.md rule 12's named exceptions to 'No deletion'. CLAUDE10.md states them in prose for a human; this file states the same exceptions in a form a program can act on; .claude/hooks/test/test-rule12-exceptions.sh fails when the two stop agreeing. Nothing here grants anything: the authority is CLAUDE10.md, and an entry that cannot be traced back to its text is a test failure, not a permission.

exceptions.what: the throwaway Docker containers, image tags and networks this project itself creates
exceptions.recoverable_how: the image lineage stays on disk; a stopped container is not what makes a run reproducible

mechanism.summary: named targets only, under CLAUDE10.md §5a; docker system/container/image/volume/network prune is forbidden without exception

exceptions.what: apps/webui-react/ — three files, twelve lines, superseded by apps/webui-static
exceptions.recoverable_how: git history and the sealed archives (SHA-256 recorded)

mechanism.summary: a completed one-off act, recorded in D-0195; it authorises no recurring removal

exceptions.what: the e2e probe's own per-run workspaces under NOESAR_ARTIFACT_ROOT
exceptions.recoverable_how: NOT recoverable — no git history, no archive; bounded by a pattern a test enforces rather than by care

mechanism.summary: only tools/e2e-retention-policy.sh's e2e_retention_prunable(), driven by tools/run-browser-e2e.sh (NOESAR_E2E_RETAIN, default 5) or tools/test-e2e-retention.sh; never the newest NOESAR_E2E_RETAIN runs, never a glob, never an ad-hoc rm

exceptions.what: the host cache reclaim (docker build cache, Claude Code's claude_tmp contents) and superseded project directories directly under /mnt/cachec, each named individually by the Owner and recorded in docs/DECISION_LOG.md before removal
exceptions.recoverable_how: NOT recoverable — no git history, no archive, no backup was taken or asked for; bounded by an explicit protected list a test enforces, rather than by care

mechanism.summary: only tools/cache-cleanup.sh's cache_cleanup_removable(), proven by tools/test-cache-cleanup.sh; it refuses every protected name (NOESAR, NOESAR_EVOLUTION*, ATOM*, NOESAR-ATOM-PRIVATE), any path not directly under the cache root, any '..', any symlink and anything that is not an existing directory. filesystem_roots is deliberately empty: no ad-hoc rm is covered anywhere, so the guard keeps denying every one of them and the tool stays the only route. docker builder prune is permitted; docker system/container/image/volume prune stay forbidden by §5a 21d
